proposed_comments.title: Refresh uxtheme color policy before reapplying the menu mode
proposed_comments.body:
### Refresh uxtheme color policy before reapplying the menu mode

**Severity:** `medium`

`Refresh()` currently only calls `Initialize()`, so a live theme switch can leave uxtheme's cached immersive color policy stale when `IsDarkModeEnabled()` runs. Load ordinal 104 (`RefreshImmersiveColorPolicyState`) and call it before querying the theme, then reapply the preferred mode and flush the menu themes; verify by switching Windows between light and dark while Runner remains running and reopening the tray menu.

confidence.rationale: The exact upstream Refresh implementation only calls Initialize, while the existing ZoomIt implementation refreshes uxtheme's cached immersive policy through ordinal 104 before querying and applying menu mode.

proposed_comments.title: Use the system theme signal consistently
proposed_comments.body:
### Use the system theme signal consistently

**Severity:** `medium`

`ShouldAppsUseDarkMode()` follows the app color preference, while the runner's tray icon and theme listener use `SystemUsesLightTheme`. In Windows Custom mode those values can differ, so the new menu can render opposite to the tray icon; use `ThemeHelpers::GetSystemTheme()` for this helper's decision.

```suggestion
return ThemeHelpers::GetSystemTheme() == Theme::Dark;
```

confidence.rationale: The tray icon and registered callback use the system-theme registry signal, while ShouldAppsUseDarkMode follows the app-theme signal. The exact minimized replacement built successfully on the pinned upstream head.
